Also he illegally evaded tax: not collecting vehicle purchase tax, false declaration, causing tax loss. That is "逃税罪" (tax evasion) or "偷税罪". Under Chinese law, "偷税罪" (tax evasion) is a crime. Also "徇私舞弊不征、少征税款" could be "徇私舞弊不征税罪" (abuse of power to not collect tax). The relevant offense: "徇私舞弊不征税罪" (abuse of official power to not collect tax). Also "变造国家机关证件罪". Possibly also "受贿罪"? He used position to get blank certificates, but not necessarily receiving bribes. He obtained blank certificates by abusing position, maybe "职务侵占"? But main is forging documents and tax evasion.

The correction rules: When forging state-issued documents, list all applicable offenses: 伪造、变造、买卖国... Here we have 变造国家机关证件. Also maybe "伪造国家机关证件罪". In Chinese law, the crime is "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". The act of forging is 伪造. The facts say "变造". So we list "变造国家机关证件罪". Also "徇私舞弊不征税罪". Possibly also "偷税罪". But "徇私舞弊不征税罪" is specific for officials. So we list both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]变造国家机关证件罪;徇私舞弊不征税罪<eoa>
